hello.note: New Zealand's iconic all-purpose greeting; also used to say thanks.

goodbye.note: Said to the person staying behind; 'Haere rā' is said to the person leaving.

thank_you.note: Kia ora is also commonly used as a casual thanks.

youre_welcome.note: Literally 'it's nothing'; a warm reply to thanks.

please.note: Added to the end of a request, similar to English 'please'.

excuse_me.note: Used to politely get someone's attention.

sorry.note: Literally an appeal for compassion; a warm, sincere apology.

of_course.note: Literally 'yes indeed'; an emphatic, enthusiastic yes.

amazing.note: Literally 'the awe strikes home'; an enthusiastic exclamation.

cheers.note: The same all-purpose 'Kia ora' doubles as a toast when raising a glass; Te Aka Māori Dictionary lists 'cheers' among its core meanings.
